function: This protein specifically catalyzes the removal of signal peptides from prolipoproteins.

catalytic_activity.equation: Release of signal peptides from bacterial membrane prolipoproteins. Hydrolyzes -Xaa-Yaa-Zaa-|-(S,diacylglyceryl)Cys-, in which Xaa is hydrophobic (preferably Leu), and Yaa (Ala or Ser) and Zaa (Gly or Ala) have small, neutral side chains.

            <ns0:text>Release of signal peptides from bacterial membrane prolipoproteins. Hydrolyzes -Xaa-Yaa-Zaa-|-(S,diacylglyceryl)Cys-, in which Xaa is hydrophobic (preferably Leu), and Yaa (Ala or Ser) and Zaa (Gly or Ala) have small, neutral side chains.</ns0:text>
            <ns0:dbReference type="EC" id="3.4.23.36" />
        </ns0:reaction>
    </ns0:comment>

pathway: Protein modification; lipoprotein biosynthesis (signal peptide cleavage).
